## v1.41.0

`mgmt.doctorProbe` can now probe agents that call client tools. It answers a waiting tool for you, so the turn no longer stalls until the tool timeout. The probe can also return the reply text and ignore symbols you allow. `SILENT_OPENING` is now `-`, because the older `<blank>` phrase no longer ends the opening turn. Agents that store `<blank>` need one update, and the doctor finds them. Every new option is optional and every new result field is additive.

### Added

- `doctorProbe` accepts `clientTools`: an object keyed by tool name. Each value is a JSON answer, or a function `(args, call) => answer` (sync or async). The probe sends it when the agent waits for that tool. (#495)
- The reply reports `toolAcks` (one entry per answered tool, with `ok` and a `reason` on failure) and `unansweredTools` (waiting tools that had no answer). (#495)
- On a timeout, `error.unansweredTools` lists the waiting tools. The message names them and shows the `clientTools` key to pass. (#495)
- A `clientTools` function that does not finish within `timeoutMs` is reported as `handler_timeout`, so the probe always returns near `timeoutMs`. (#495)
- `doctorProbe` accepts `includeText: true`. The reply then carries `text`. (#495)
- `spoken.allowSymbols` takes any of `% $ & € £ #` and leaves them out of `reply.spoken.symbols`. `reply.spoken.digitRuns` lists the digit runs found, so you can allow `2026` and flag `183`. `digits` is unchanged. (#495)
- The `client_tool_wait_blocks` fix text points to `clientTools`. (#495)
- `scripts/doctor.mjs --probe` lists the client tools that held the turn and says it cannot answer them. (#495)
- `silent_opening_legacy_phrase` (warn): the opening line holds `<blank>`. (#PR)
- `silent_opening_unsupported_voice` (error): the opening line is silent and an avatar voice is a Cartesia voice, where no silent phrase ended the opening turn in tests. Use a short spoken opening there. (#PR)

### Changed

- `SILENT_OPENING` is `-`. On ElevenLabs voices it ends the opening turn in under half a second with no sound. The older `<blank>` phrase never ends there. `isSilentOpening` and the `[silence]` label still recognise `<blank>`. (#PR)

### Behavior change

- Agents that already store `<blank>` as `opening_phrase`: set `SILENT_OPENING` with `intellectConfig.setOpeningPhrase(configId, SILENT_OPENING, ks)`. Until then every `speak()` and the kickoff wait for an opening turn that does not end. (#PR)

### Docs and skill

- `docs/START-THE-CONVERSATION.md` says which voices a silent opening works on, and a troubleshooting row for an agent that never answers. `docs/DOCTOR.md` lists the two new codes. (#PR)
- `docs/DOCTOR.md` has a "Client tools that wait" section and rows for the new fields. (#495)
- `docs/EAR-TEST-RECIPE.md` is a recipe to hear how a voice says a number, an acronym or a name, using only the public API. (#495)
- `catalog.createVoice`, `docs/api/design.md`, `docs/LANGUAGES.md` and the README now say how to find a voice's TTS provider and that `language` is a label. (#495)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.40.0...v1.41.0
